background: Angela Montenegro is a member of the Jeffersonian Institute Medico-Legal Lab team. She works closely with Dr. Temperance Brennan, providing her expertise in forensic art to help identify and reconstruct the faces of victims from their remains. Her role is crucial in the investigative process, often leading to breakthroughs in cases. While the text does not provide extensive background details about Angela, it is clear that she is an integral part of the team and contributes significantly to the show's premise of solving crimes through scientific methods.
